verdict.rationale: Lovable's getting-started docs describe remixing, which makes an independent, editable copy of an existing project on any plan. That is a non-blank starting point. A hands-on community report also confirms a user signed up and 'picked a template', so templates do exist. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a template gallery, documentation that remixing works on public community projects (a community showcase or discovery feature), and detail on what templates contain.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start from a template or community project instead of a blank prompt

citations.quote: Remixing creates your own independent copy that you can edit freely, on any plan.
Signed up for Lovable, picked a template
